description: This file implements the WiFi Manager connection handling for a network management system, including functions for connecting and disconnecting to WiFi networks, parsing parameters from JSON objects, and interfacing with underlying system APIs via IARM Bus calls.

classes.name: WifiManagerConnect
classes.description: A class that manages WiFi connection operations including connect and disconnect, utilizing IARM bus calls and handling JSON parameters.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Handles the process of establishing a WiFi connection based on JSON parameters, including SSID, passphrase, and security mode.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnecting from the current WiFi network via an IARM bus call.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Internal method to initiate a WiFi connection with specified SSID, passphrase, and security mode.
